summary.note: Tier-A no-rebuild validation only. Coverage (Tier B llvm_cov/gcov) and taint (Tier C dfsan) require an instrumentation rebuild in the arvo container, deferred under qemu emulation.

R1_parser_admitted.evidence: The crash is reached only by decoding the op stream and selecting op 26. ASan crash frame #1 = FuzzPath fuzz/FuzzCommon.cpp:145 (the op-26 dispatch path->reverseAddPath(*path)), which is dominated within the same for-loop by the op decode at line 22. Op-dispatch admission is thus witnessed.

R2_source_reached.evidence: Directly witnessed: ASan allocation stack frame #11 = FuzzPath fuzz/FuzzCommon.cpp:114. The source builds the rounded rect whose conic verbs allocate the fConicWeights buffer.

R3_vulnerable_function_reached.evidence: Directly witnessed: ASan crash frame #0 and free frame #8 are both SkPath::reverseAddPath.

R4_vulnerable_line_reached.evidence: Line 1748 directly witnessed (crash frame #0 at 1748:47, free frame #8 at 1748:23). Root-cause line 1712 (Editor construction / missing this==src guard) is confirmed by patch_differential: the fix inserts the aliasing guard here and the crash disappears. Line 1712 is not an ASan frame but dominates the reverse-walk loop that reaches 1748.

R5_sink_reached.evidence: Directly witnessed: ASan heap-use-after-free READ of size 4 at 0x603000000220 (0 bytes inside freed 24-byte region), crash frame #0 = SkPath::reverseAddPath src/core/SkPath.cpp:1748:47.

S1_target_crash.evidence: docker run n132/arvo:10318-vul /bin/arvo run -> ASan ABORTING, SUMMARY heap-use-after-free at src/core/SkPath.cpp:1748:47. Reproduced deterministically.

patch_differential.evidence: Same poc (44 bytes): n132/arvo:10318-vul -> ASan HUAF crash (exit 1); n132/arvo:10318-fix -> 'Execution successful' (exit 0). The fix (commit 8051d383) adds the this==src deep-copy guard in SkPath::reverseAddPath. vul_crashes && fix_clean confirms the missing aliasing guard at src/core/SkPath.cpp:1712 is the root cause.

tier_b_coverage.reason: Line coverage (-fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping / gcov) needs an instrumentation rebuild in the arvo container; slow/out of budget under arm64->amd64 qemu emulation. Intermediate node reachability (materialization at 1718) left deferred rather than asserted.

tier_c_taint.reason: DFSan (-fsanitize=dataflow) taint edge source->sink requires a harness change + rebuild; deferred to a native amd64 host.

gt_consistency.notes: GT sink (SkPath.cpp:1748), root_cause (SkPath.cpp:1712), source (FuzzCommon.cpp:114), and alloc (SkPath.cpp:1208) all match the observed ASan crash/free/allocation stacks. Minor: GT bug_description.original quotes crash address 0x6040000003e0 (upstream OSS-Fuzz report), but the local arvo reproduction and GT sanitizer_ground_truth both use 0x603000000220 (the actual local region); not a structured-GT defect.
